submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint ONE independently hand-drawn native square 1254x1254 transparent RGBA full-body game sprite of this exact celestial musician girl. Single pose, one character, no sheet. Image1=identity and immutable hand ownership, Image2=direction and camera reference, Image3=approved clean bright rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted style; any Image4 is same-direction scale/continuity anchor. Keep purple high bun long hair, gold lotus/pearl crown, violet eyes, ivory-lavender-gold embroidered long sleeves, short tunic over puffy lavender trousers, ivory-purple boots, green waist knot, ONE rigid elongated flat purple-gold qin. Anatomical LEFT supports upper qin, anatomical RIGHT rests/grips lower string face, both hands continuously attached during run. Both shoulders and elbows rotate naturally with stride while retaining grips, no hand swap. Two arms and two legs only, coherent hips/knees/ankles and boot toes; do not hide all feet under skirt. Preserve actual alpha, translucent ribbons. Full silhouette within clear margins. Same global head/body size and camera, no zoom, no individual bbox fit or grounded recentering. Virtual canvas 1024 root(512,942), floor92%canvas. Head crown around13%canvas in contact phase and boots near92%, with small true run bob. STRICT SOUTH facing straight TOWARD VIEWER, front view, symmetric violet eyes, no sideways turn. Anatomical RIGHT arm/leg on SCREEN LEFT; LEFT arm/leg on SCREEN RIGHT. LEFT hand SCREEN RIGHT supports upper qin end at upper-right; RIGHT hand SCREEN LEFT lower strings at lower-left. Trace both arm chains and never swap. FRAME S05 of16, cycle cadence to review at640/720/800ms: FIRST SHORT FLIGHT with LEFT leading. Keep exact face/head/upper-body dimensions from image4 and safe crown margin, no zoom. BOTH KNEES BEND and both BOOTS LIFT clearly off floor. Anatomical LEFT thigh SCREEN RIGHT drives forward, left knee sharply bent, LEFT boot at(x745,y1040) showing some sole toward camera. RIGHT thigh SCREEN LEFT trails away, right knee folds back with SMALL right boot at(x515,y980). Lowest boot edges ABOVEy1120, bottom130pixels transparent. Head/hip rise only small amount, do not lengthen either shin to fill bottom. Exactly two leg chains, left high knee in front, right folded behind. Qin tilts with shoulders but left hand upperright/right lowerleft always attached. Hair, sleeves and ribbons lag naturally and change with gait. No background, ground, shadow, text, border, particles, glow, motion lines, trails, extra props. Highest visual finish; project target2.5Sunburst/max is host-managed, not a submitted model parameter.
